policy_clauses_reverified.section: Section 5, Identifying Yourself as an Associate
policy_clauses_reverified.quote_observed_verbatim: You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site or any other location where Amazon may authorize your display or other use of Program Content: “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.”

For the avoidance of doubt and without limitation for purposes of the foregoing subsection (a) any violation of Section 5 and as specified in the Program Policies will be deemed a material breach of this Agreement.

policy_clauses_reverified.section: Participation Requirements 2(b), General Requirements Applicable to All Special Links
policy_clauses_reverified.quote_observed_verbatim: For example, you must include your Associates ID or “tag” (appearing as XXXXX-##, or such other format as we may designate) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.

Product prices and availability may vary from time to time. Because prices for and availability of Products that you have listed on your Site may change, your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements regarding use of Creators API or PA API in the License.
policy_clauses_reverified.bearing: This is the clause that governs whether a price may appear on the site at all. See I-F-01.

policy_clauses_reverified.quote_observed_verbatim: You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements for Creators API and PA API described in the License.
policy_clauses_reverified.bearing: This is the clause that governs whether a star rating may appear on the site at all. See I-F-01.

policy_clauses_reverified.quote_observed_verbatim: You will not use a link shortening service, button, hyperlink or other ad placement in a manner that makes it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site.

(e) any Product purchased by a customer who is referred to an Amazon Site by a link that sends users indirectly to an Amazon Site via an intermediate site, without requiring the customer to click on a link or take some other affirmative action on that intermediate site (a “Redirecting Link”),
Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.

Your Site(s) must contain original content and be publicly available via the website address provided in the application. Original content utilizing third-party materials must contain significant commentary, analysis, or transformation to any materials you include.

You will not, without our express prior written approval, access or use Creators API, PA API or Data Feeds for the purpose of aggregating, analyzing, extracting, or repurposing any Product Advertising Content or in connection with any software or other application intended for use by persons or entities that offer products on an Amazon Site, or in the direct training or fine-tuning of a machine learning and/or foundational model.
policy_clauses_reverified.bearing: Constrains what the platform's own analysis step may do with Amazon data. Recorded as a design constraint, not as an entitlement.

policy_clauses_reverified.quote_observed_verbatim: Unless otherwise notified by us, you may store individual Amazon Standard Identification Numbers (ASINs) for an indefinite period until the termination of this License.

You will include a date/time stamp adjacent to your display of pricing or availability information on your application if you obtain Product Advertising Content from Data Feeds, or if you call Creators API, PA API or refresh the Product Advertising Content displayed on your application less frequently than hourly.
policy_clauses_reverified.bearing: Applies only if a price is displayed lawfully in the first place. It cannot be used to make an otherwise prohibited display compliant.

policy_clauses_reverified.quote_observed_verbatim: Have at least 10 qualifying sales within the past 30 days to access the PA API through the Creators API
policy_clauses_reverified.bearing: Explains why no product, price or rating data can be pulled from Amazon by this project today.

policy_clauses_reverified.quote_observed_verbatim: “ASIN” stands for “Amazon Standard Identification Number.” It’s a unique 10-character alphanumeric code assigned to every product listed in the Amazon store.
policy_clauses_reverified.bearing: Second official Amazon statement of the 10-character rule. The three submitted codes are 9 characters, so they cannot be ASINs.

policy_clauses_reverified.section: What About Affiliate or Network Marketing? — first question
policy_clauses_reverified.quote_observed_verbatim: You should disclose your relationship to the retailer clearly and conspicuously on your site, so readers can decide how much weight to give your endorsement. ... The closer the disclosure is to your recommendation, the better.

policy_clauses_reverified.section: What About Affiliate or Network Marketing? — second question
policy_clauses_reverified.quote_observed_verbatim: Consumers might not understand that “affiliate link” means that the person placing the link is getting paid for purchases made through the link. Similarly, a “buy now” button would not be adequate.

policy_clauses_reverified.section: Other Things for Endorsers and Advertisers to Know
policy_clauses_reverified.quote_observed_verbatim: You can’t talk about your experience with a product if you haven’t tried it.
policy_clauses_reverified.bearing: Binding on the marketing copy: the site must not imply first-hand use of a product it has not tested.
